description: Ingest pipeline for frame performance metrics. Validates ranges and derives stutter flag from frametime variance.

script.source: if (ctx.fps?.current != null && ctx.fps.current < 0) { throw new Exception('fps.current must be >= 0, got: ' + ctx.fps.current); } if (ctx.fps?.frametime_ms != null && ctx.fps.frametime_ms < 0) { throw new Exception('fps.frametime_ms must be >= 0'); }

script.description: Derive stutter flag when frametime variance exceeds threshold (> 8ms indicates micro-stutter)
script.source: if (ctx.fps?.frametime_variance != null) { ctx.fps.stutter_detected = ctx.fps.frametime_variance > 8.0; } else { ctx.fps.stutter_detected = false; }
